have : 5 + 6 / 10 = 56 / 10 := by ring
  have : 56 / 10 = 28 / 5 := by simp [div_eq_mul_inv]
  have : 28 / 5 = 5.6 := by simp [real_of_nat, real_div_eq_mul_inv, real_of_nat_eq_coe_num]

  have h_bounds : ∀ n : ℤ, n ∈ S ↔ (n - 2).abs ≤ 5.6 := h₀

  -- The inequality |x-2| ≤ 5.6 translates to -5.6 ≤ x-2 ≤ 5.6
  -- Which is equivalent to -3.6 ≤ x ≤ 7.6
  have h_range : ∀ n : ℤ, n ∈ S ↔ (-3.6 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 7.6) := by
    intro n
    simp [h_bounds] at h_bounds n
    split_ifs with h_abs_le
    · rw [h_abs_le]
      simp [abs_le] at h_abs_le
      split_ifs with h_le
      · rw [h_le]
        simp [sub_le] at h_le
        split_ifs with h_le' h_le''
        · rw [h_le']
          simp [sub_le] at h_le'
          simp [le_sub] at h_le''
          simp [le_sub] at h_le''
      · rw [h_le]
        simp [sub_le] at h_le
        split_ifs with h_le' h_le''
        · rw [h_le']
          simp [sub_le] at h_le'
          simp [le_sub] at h_le''
          simp [le_sub] at h_le''
    · rw [h_abs_le]
      simp [abs_le] at h_abs_le
      split_ifs with h_le
      · rw [h_le]
        simp [sub_le] at h_le
        split_ifs with h_le' h_le''
        · rw [h_le']
          simp [sub_le] at h_le'
          simp [le_sub] at h_le''
          simp [le_sub] at h_le''
      · rw [h_le]
        simp [sub_le] at h_le
        split_ifs with h_le' h_le''
        · rw [h_le']
          simp [sub_le] at h_le'
          simp [le_sub] at h_le''
          simp [le_sub] at h_le''

  -- Find all integer n such that -3.6 ≤ n ≤ 7.6
  have : ∀ n : ℤ, n ∈ S ↔ (n ≥ -3 ∧ n ≤ 7) := by
    intro n
    simp [h_range] at h_range n
    split_ifs with h_le h_le'
    · rw [h_le h_le']
      simp [le_of_le_of_le] at h_le h_le'
      split_ifs with h_le'' h_le'''
      · rw [h_le'']
        simp [le_of_le_of_le] at h_le''
        simp [le_of_le_of_le] at h_le''
      · rw [h_le'' h_le''']
        simp [le_of_le_of_le] at h_le'' h_le'''
        simp [le_of_le_of_le] at h_le'''
    · rw [h_le h_le']
      simp [le_of_le_of_le] at h_le h_le'
      split_ifs with h_le'' h_le'''
      · rw [h_le'']
        simp [le_of_le_of_le] at h_le''
        simp [le_of_le_of_le] at h_le''
      · rw [h_le'' h_le''']
        simp [le_of_le_of_le] at h_le'' h_le'''
        simp [le_of_le_of_le] at h_le'''

  -- The integers satisfying -3 ≤ n ≤ 7 are exactly -3, -2, ..., 7
  have : S = Finset.univ.inter {n : ℤ | -3 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 7} := by
    rw [Finset.mem_univ]
    simp [h_range]

  -- The set of integers between -3 and 7 inclusive is exactly the set {-3, -2, ..., 7}
  have : {n : ℤ | -3 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 7} = Finset.range (-3) (7 + 1) := by
    ext n
    simp [Finset.mem_range]
    split_ifs with h_le h_le'
    · rw [h_le h_le']
      simp [le_of_le_of_le] at h_le h_le'
      simp [le_of_le_of_le] at h_le h_le'
    · rw [h_le h_le']
      simp [le_of_le_of_le] at h_le h_le'
      simp [le_of_le_of_le] at h_le h_le'

  -- The cardinality of the range from -3 to 7 inclusive is 11
  rw [this]
  rw [Finset.card_range]
  simp [Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_lt, Nat.lt_succ_self]
  ring_nf
